name: Houses Manager
description: Gerencia as casas pelo painel do admin (admin/?p=houses): une o XML do mapa (otservbr-house.xml: rent, nome, tamanho, camas, guildhall, townid, clientid) e a tabela OT `houses` (owner, estado, leilao). Permite editar rent e regenerar o houses.json do client na raiz do site. Nao mexe no core do MyAAC.
author: silverlake-ot
